title: PLAYGROUND ARTIFICIAL TURF INSTALLATION, REPAIR, & GROOMING CONTRACT

onscreen_lines.note: Includes site prep, full glue/tape application and perimeter kerfing installation. Contractor is to use high-tensile 12-inch outdoor seaming tape, full non-water-soluble single-component polyurethane adhesive along all seams.
onscreen_lines.block: 1 Artificial Turf Supply & Full Installation 1 SF No Response

onscreen_lines.note: Saw-cutting asphalt perimeter. Contractor is to cut art a minimum 3/8" wide x 1.5" deep. Kerf cuts are to anchored with polyurethane adhesive along borders.
onscreen_lines.block: 2 Perimeter Asphalt Saw-Cutting & Edging Preparation 1 LF No Response

onscreen_lines.note: All expansion gaps, joints, bevels, cracks, and voids between playground tiles must be filled and leveled.
onscreen_lines.block: 3 Buffing Application & Gap Remediation 1 LF No Response

onscreen_lines.note: Complete mechanical brush-grooming, de-compaction, organic debris removal, and infill redistribution across the designated playground site.
onscreen_lines.block: 5 Annual Grooming Service 1 SF No Response

onscreen_lines.note: Infill replenishment using rounded, non-abrasive infill (sub-angular sand or organic/coated infill).

On-Site testing and certified compliance report per playground site. The field drops must be conducted using a calibrated tri-axial accelerometer by a Certified Playground Safety Inspector (CPSI), with certified test reports submitted within 5 business days showing Gmax < 200g and Head Injury Criterion (HIC) < 1,000.
onscreen_lines.block: 7 Impact Attenuation Testing 1 EA No Response
